description.zh:
切换网络类型为VPC时，设置保留原经典网络地址的时长。取值为**14**、**30**、**60**、**120**，单位为天。

> 当**NetworkType**参数配置为**VPC**且**RetainClassic**参数配置为**True**时，需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The retention period of the original classic network address when you switch the network type to VPC. Settings. Valid values: **14**, **30**, **60**, and **120**. Unit: days.

> This parameter is required when the **NetworkType** parameter settings is set to **VPC** and the **RetainClassic** parameter settings is set to **True**.

description.zh:
实例要切换的目标网络类型，取值说明：
- **VPC**：将网络类型切换为专有网络。
description.en:
The target network type to which you want to switch the instance. Valid values:
- **VPC**: switches the network type to VPC.

description.zh:
切换网络类型为VPC时，设置是否保留原经典网络地址，取值说明：
- **True**：保留原经典网络地址。
- **False**：不保留原经典网络地址。

> - 当**NetworkType**参数配置为**VPC**时，需要配置该参数。
> - 当该参数配置为**True**时，还需要配置**ClassicExpiredDays**参数。
description.en:
Specifies whether to retain the original classic network address when you switch the network type to VPC. Settings. Valid values:
- **True**: retains the original classic network address.
- **False**: does not retain the original classic network address.

> - This parameter is required when the **NetworkType** parameter settings is set to **VPC**.
> - If this parameter settings is set to **True**, you must also specify the **ClassicExpiredDays** parameter.

description.zh:
专有网络中的交换机ID。
> 当**NetworkType**参数配置为**VPC**时，需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The vSwitch ID in the VPC.
> This parameter is required when the **NetworkType** parameter settings is set to **VPC**.

description.zh:
专有网络ID。

> 当**NetworkType**参数配置为**VPC**时，需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The VPC ID.

> This parameter is required when the **NetworkType** parameter settings is set to **VPC**.

description.zh: 可用区ID，您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~61933~~)接口查询可用区ID。
description.en: The zone ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the zone ID.

title.en: Switch the network type of an instance

descriptions.zh:
- 该接口适用于副本集实例和分片集群实例，暂不支持单节点实例。且仅支持经典网络类型转换至VPC网络类型。
- 该接口仅支持MongoDB 4.2及以下版本的本地盘版实例。
descriptions.en:
- This operation applies to replica set instances and sharded cluster instances. Single-node instances are not supported. Only the transform from the classic network type to the VPC network type is supported.
- This operation supports only instances that run MongoDB 4.2 or earlier and use local disks.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-db-instance-network-type --db-instance-id dds-bp11483712c10000 --network-type VPC --vpc-id vpc-bp1n3i15v90el48nx0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1vj604nj5a9zz740000 --retain-classic False --classic-expired-days 30 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds ModifyDBInstanceNetworkType --region cn-hangzhou --RetainClassic False --VpcId 'vpc-bp1n3i15v90el48nx0000' --ClassicExpiredDays 30 --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --DBInstanceId 'dds-bp11483712c10000' --NetworkType VPC --VSwitchId 'vsw-bp1vj604nj5a9zz740000'
